rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder; the policy is auto_full coverage and clearly covers this incident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM when struck by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is on the police report. This high-severity claim requires immediate vehicle inspection and injury assessment.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other driver at ~35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat; entire vehicle totaled

rationale: A tree falling onto a parked vehicle and causing damage to the hood and windshield is a comprehensive (not collision) auto insurance claim.
claim_summary: Maple tree from policyholder's own front yard fell in wind and struck parked vehicle in driveway, damaging hood and windshield. Vehicle damage is the primary loss; no structural damage to home or injuries reported.

case_facts.description: maple tree fell in wind and landed on parked car
